claims: The 2027 Masters ticket lottery application window will be open from June 1–20, 2026, on the official Masters website.
Fans can apply for practice rounds (Mon–Wed) and daily tournament rounds (Thu–Sun) for the 2027 tournament.
2027 Masters ticket lottery winners are selected randomly.
2027 Masters ticket lottery winners are notified in July 2026.
2027 Masters ticket lottery applications require creating or updating an account at tickets.masters.com.
2027 Masters ticket prices are not finalized.
The 2027 Masters ticket lottery has estimated success rates of roughly 0.55%.
Applicants for the 2027 Masters ticket lottery can apply for multiple days.
The 2027 Masters ticket lottery awards only one day (if any) per applicant.
Applications for the Augusta National Women's Amateur and Drive, Chip and Putt finals are part of the 2027 Masters ticket lottery process.
2027 Masters ticket lottery winners will need to pay for their tickets in July 2026.
